localFacts.fact: Destatis: Frauen in Deutschland sind im Schnitt 1,66 m groß, Männer 1,79 m. Replaces the CDC US averages (63.5 in / 68.9 in) in the eye-level section.

Lufthansa allows carry-on bags of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm. The Sirui (33 cm), Peak Design (39,4 cm) and Befree Advanced (40 cm) fold shorter than 55 cm; the Manfrotto 190XPRO kit (70,5 cm) and the Vanguard (about 72 cm) do not.

Kölner Dom (Domordnung): private photos without flash are allowed, but "Aufnahmen mit Stativen bedürfen einer Genehmigung durch den Dompropst". A family photo with tripod inside the cathedral needs permission.

German terms: Kugelkopf (ball head), Mittelsäule (centre column), Selbstauslöser (self-timer), Fernauslöser (remote shutter release), Intervallaufnahme (interval shooting), Schnellwechselplatte; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: Running back to the camera for every frame with the self-timer.
localPainPoints.fix: Use interval shooting or a remote shutter release (post: how-to step 4-5 and the 'running back' pain point).

quotes.text: Die ersten 2-3 Bilder beim Intervall sind natürlich nichts, dafür muss man nicht für jedes Bild wieder zur Kamera rennen.

localPainPoints.pain: With the self-timer the camera focuses on the background (the wall) before the parent is in the picture, so the family is blurred.
localPainPoints.fix: Have one person stand in place, focus on their eyes, then switch the lens to manual focus to lock it (post how-to step 3); or fire from the phone app.

quotes.text: Jetzt habe ich versucht mittels Selbstauslöser mit 3 Fotos Aufnahmen von uns zu machen und wir sind komplett unscharf, aber die Wand ist scharf.

localPainPoints.pain: Forum users warn against gaining height with a long, wobbly centre column.
localPainPoints.fix: Compare column-down heights and raise the column only for the last centimetres, indoors or on calm days (post: height section and 'shake with the column up').

quotes.text: Auf lange, windige Mittelsäulenkonstruktionen würde ich jedenfalls verzichten.

localGain.point: Eye-level targets recomputed for German averages (Destatis): women 1,66 m -> about 136 to 141 cm on the legs; men 1,79 m -> about 149 to 154 cm. Column down, Manfrotto (146,5 cm) and Vanguard (about 141 cm) clear the women's target, Peak Design (130,2 cm) and Befree (128 cm) fall about 6 to 13 cm short; for the average German man none reaches it, the Manfrotto comes closest at about 2,5 cm short.
Lufthansa cabin bag 55 x 40 x 23 cm: only the three travel tripods (33 to 40 cm folded) fit lengthwise, the two full-size kits (70,5 and about 72 cm) do not.
Holiday family photo at a church or cathedral: Kölner Dom requires permission from the Dompropst for tripod shots.
Maker metric figures (146,5 cm, 128 cm, 130,2 cm, 138 cm) instead of conversions.
